propositions: Operation certificates are migrated from per-clone symmetric HMAC self-attestations to asymmetric Ed25519 signatures verifiable by any third party against a signing environment's public key.
Each certificate is attributed to the signing environment under namespace rebar.opcert.v1 and registered as a new kind in the attest registry POLICY table.

A project can optionally require a certificate from a specific trusted environment whose public keys are pinned out-of-band in .rebar/trusted_environments.yaml, verified against the pinned key rather than the DSSE-claimed key_id.
A merge-gate CI lane extends the shipped verify-identity.yaml walk to verify the required-environment certificate over the merged log and fails tickets lacking a required cert.
Certificates bind {ticket id, material fingerprint, merged-log position} and key-validity is evaluated at the SIGNATURE event's storage anchor to prevent replay and rollback of revoked-key certs.

A trusted rebar-mcp remote path fetches authoritative ticket state and code-at-commit itself and signs on that, while the legacy HMAC scheme is removed via an expand-contract migration and the default local offline path never wedges.
